title: Haghtanak (Victory) Bridge

groundCutout.basis: Bounded under-bridge opening for coarse PMTiles gorge terrain; approximate visualization, no surveyed canyon.

terrainReference.basis: Standard PMTiles western approach road contact; no surveyed datum.

note: Inspected pictures confirm three main basalt arches, open spandrels, lattice iron railings and globe lamps. The retained mapped190×30m bridge outline and current standard viewer PMTiles named Victory Bridge roads establish the centre and southeast-facing native+X. Approximate nativebase929.3304m uses the western approach PMTiles sample963.3304m at road modelY34; the opposite approach differs1.4m. Coarse central terrain is about22m above that inferred base and does not resolve the lower gorge. A bounded ground opening below the interior bridge preserves visible vaults while the original PMTiles surroundings remain; this is an approximate visualization, not a surveyed canyon or road endpoint certification. The preview grades only a bounded under-bridge corridor to the inferred gorge base; raw terrain-review and pmtiles-fit samples remain preserved and this is not source bathymetry. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.
